statement: A frame's content name and a refusal have digests of their own (frameAuthDigest, refusalAuthDigest), tagged with their kind and scoped to the chain, the Depository, both entities of the Account (smaller id first) and the epoch, and a frame's digest also names its proof nonce, so a signature on one is never valid as the other, as a dispute proof, on another Account, in another epoch or at another nonce; every field is written as text and the fields cannot be shifted into one another, so a digest exists whatever a peer put on the wire. This row holds the digests only. No Runtime, Entity or Host signs or checks either of them today: a frame is authenticated by the signature over its head (R-SIGNED-HEADS-ON-THE-WIRE), and a refusal by the link alone (R-LINK-AUTH), so R-FRAME-REFUSAL rests on the link's authenticated peer, not on a signature. Owed: either put these signatures on the wire or retire the digests.
source: Review B of PR 85 (finding 5, note 5); coordinator 10-01 04:24 (A4b: signed bytes for frames and refusals)
